mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS customerId, c.name AS customerName, c.owner AS owner, c.follow_time AS followTime, COALESCE(t.contractAmount, 0) AS contractAmount FROM customer c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT customer_id, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS contractAmount FROM contract WHERE organization_id = #{orgId} AND (void_reason IS NULL OR void_reason = '') GROUP BY customer_id ) t ON t.customer_id = c.id WHERE c.organization_id = #{orgId} AND c.in_shared_pool = 0 AND c.owner IS NOT NULL AND c.owner != '' AND (c.follow_time IS NULL OR c.follow_time < #{staleBefore}) ORDER BY COALESCE(t.contractAmount, 0) DESC, c.follow_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, organization_id AS organizationId, action_type AS actionType, agent_id AS agentId, resource_type AS resourceType, resource_id AS resourceId, resource_name AS resourceName, customer_id AS customerId, customer_name AS customerName, owner_id AS ownerId, payload, status, result, confirm_user AS confirmUser, confirm_time AS confirmTime, create_user AS createUser, update_user AS updateUser, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM ai_employee_action WHERE organization_id = #{orgId} AND status = 'PENDING'

SELECT id, organization_id AS organizationId, action_type AS actionType, agent_id AS agentId, resource_type AS resourceType, resource_id AS resourceId, resource_name AS resourceName, customer_id AS customerId, customer_name AS customerName, owner_id AS ownerId, payload, status, result, confirm_user AS confirmUser, confirm_time AS confirmTime, create_user AS createUser, update_user AS updateUser, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM ai_employee_action WHERE organization_id = #{orgId} AND status = 'REJECTED' AND confirm_time IS NOT NULL AND confirm_time > #{quietBefore}

SELECT c.id AS customerId, c.name AS customerName, c.owner AS owner, c.follow_time AS followTime, 0 AS contractAmount FROM customer c WHERE c.organization_id = #{orgId} AND c.in_shared_pool = 0 AND c.owner IS NOT NULL AND c.owner != '' AND (c.follow_time IS NULL OR c.follow_time < #{churnBefore}) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM customer_tag_rel r JOIN customer_tag t ON t.id = r.tag_id AND t.organization_id = #{orgId} AND t.name = #{churnTagName} WHERE r.customer_id = c.id ) ORDER BY c.follow_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT resourceType, resourceId, resourceName, customerId, customerName, owner, dueTime, amount FROM ( SELECT 'CONTRACT' AS resourceType, c.id AS resourceId, c.name AS resourceName, c.customer_id AS customerId, cu.name AS customerName, c.owner AS owner, c.end_time AS dueTime, c.amount AS amount FROM contract c LEFT JOIN customer cu ON cu.id = c.customer_id WHERE c.organization_id = #{orgId} AND c.end_time IS NOT NULL AND c.stage != 'VOID' AND c.stage != 'COMPLETED_PERFORMANCE' AND c.owner IS NOT NULL AND c.owner != '' AND c.end_time < #{upper} AND c.end_time >= #{lower} UNION ALL SELECT 'PAYMENT_PLAN' AS resourceType, p.id AS resourceId, p.name AS resourceName, c.customer_id AS customerId, cu.name AS customerName, p.owner AS owner, p.plan_end_time AS dueTime, p.plan_amount AS amount FROM contract_payment_plan p LEFT JOIN contract c ON c.id = p.contract_id AND c.stage != 'VOID' AND c.stage != 'COMPLETED_PERFORMANCE' LEFT JOIN customer cu ON cu.id = c.customer_id WHERE p.organization_id = #{orgId} AND p.plan_status IN ('PENDING', 'PARTIALLY_COMPLETED') AND p.owner IS NOT NULL AND p.owner != '' AND p.plan_end_time < #{upper} AND p.plan_end_time >= #{lower} ) t ORDER BY dueTime ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id AS clueId, name AS clueName, owner AS owner, stage AS stage, follow_time AS followTime, contact AS contact, phone AS phone FROM clue WHERE organization_id = #{orgId} AND stage = 'INTERESTED' AND transition_id IS NULL AND owner IS NOT NULL AND owner != '' AND follow_time IS NOT NULL AND follow_time >= #{followAfter} ORDER BY follow_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.id AS customerId, c.name AS customerName, c.owner AS owner FROM customer c WHERE c.organization_id = #{orgId} AND c.in_shared_pool = 0 AND c.owner IS NOT NULL AND c.owner != '' AND ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.field_id) FROM ( SELECT field_id FROM customer_field WHERE resource_id = c.id AND field_id IN #{fid} AND field_value IS NOT NULL AND field_value != '' UNION SELECT field_id FROM customer_field_blob WHERE resource_id = c.id AND field_id IN #{fid} AND field_value IS NOT NULL AND field_value != '' ) f ) < #{requiredCount} ORDER BY c.update_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
